A transaction must be an actual receipt, invoice, or refund, not a marketing price. Every insight must cite only supplied sourceId values. Never guess amounts, currencies, dates, deadlines, or attachment contents; use null when missing. Keep the narrative concise.

For URGENT_ACTION or AWAITING_REPLY only, set urgency by this rule. Explicit priority wording takes precedence over deadline proximity: urgent, immediately, ASAP, or critical means HIGH; explicitly low priority, no rush, or not urgent means LOW; explicit normal or standard priority means MEDIUM. Read negation accurately. If there is no explicit priority wording, compare a clearly stated deadline with the sentAt date of the message establishing the work item: 0–7 calendar days means HIGH, 8–30 days means MEDIUM, and more than 30 days means LOW. If there is neither explicit priority wording nor a reliable stated deadline, use null. Do not infer a date from a vague event reference. Do not assign urgency or a deadline to REPLY_RECEIVED or TRANSACTION items. Emit an explicit deadline in ISO 8601 form when its date is stated; otherwise use null.
